title: Is it normal for a PKG to swap identity?
body: https://aur.archlinux.org/packages/lumen-bin used to be https://github.com/L-U-M-E-N/lumen-desktop but after switching mainainers, is now https://github.com/jnsahaj/lumen Is that normal? There are no comments on that PKG. What happened here? Was an orphaned PKG taken over that happens to have the same name?
